text:
marie: Quick FYI 2 launching a short 'Policy Glossary' addition to the handbook today. It's a single-page index of definitions + links so managers can answer quick Qs faster. Link: https://handbook.redwood.ai/policy-glossary :sparkles:

sam: Nice. Is this replacing the long FAQ or just a companion?

marie: Companion. The detailed policies stay in place. Glossary has short defs + a tiny 'manager talking points' box for common employee questions.

leo: Can we get a translations matrix? I'll coordinate EMEA reviews and local wording.

marie: Done 2 sheet (managers can request edit): https://sheets.redwood.ai/policy-glossary-translations
Please add region and owner in col B. Asking for first pass by end-of-day Friday.

tanya: Legal flagged one line in the data-retention blurb. I'll drop the redline in the sheet under 'legal-edits'.

devon: Training question 2 thinking short live syncs? Propose 20-min drop-ins next week (3 slots/day). Mandatory for managers or optional? :thinking_face:

marie: Mandatory for people managers and anyone in Hiring/MIC roles. ICs optional but encouraged. We'll auto-enroll managers and send calendar invites.

people-ops-bot: Reminder created: "Policy Glossary - Manager micro-session (20m)" invites will be sent to enrolled managers tomorrow at 09:00 PT.

sam: Could you also prep a one-pager I can forward to Sales? I can tailor language if needed.

marie: Yep. One-pager and a 3-slide deck in Drive 2 linked from the sheet (assets tab). If you need access ping me directly.

leo: EMEA reviewers 2 I'll scan entries for UK/GDPR implications and mark anything needing legal. ETA Thursday noon.

tanya: Thanks 2 combining legal changes with translations might shift wording, but we won't delay manager sessions; we'll append an addendum if wording changes post-session.

marie: Action items in the sheet: owner column, training RSVP, and a comms 'go-live' checkbox. I'll post a short announcement in #general after manager invites are out. :thumbsup:

devon: Added APAC as a reviewer and noted timezone preferences in the sheet.

sam: RSVP'ed for my managers.

marie: Closing the loop 2 if you need edit access DM me. Will proceed with invites at noon PT unless I hear blockers.
